<b>Vaultborn</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are young [[Keepers|acolytes]] raised in the darkest parts of the [[Whispering Vaults]], destined to become [[Scrollreader]]s.<ref>Vaultborn [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Young acolyte raised in the darkest vaults, destined to ascend to the rank of Scrollreader."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Vaultborn are often found clinging to walls or ceilings, or simply wandering back and forth. 
Vaultborn have 2 different moves:
* <b>Headbutt:</b> Tenses up and then throws itself at Hornet headfirst. Its hardy headwear prevents any damage to its head during the attack, meaning counterattacking only results in a parry.
* <b>Flutter Jump:</b> Jumps up and then swoops slightly before landing again. If they touch a wall whilst airborne, they cling to it for a moment before jumping off.

Vaultborn deal {{Damage|1}} both with their attacks and on contact.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Vaultborn have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* We are blessed! We are chosen!
* The scrolls have spoken!
* Holy words for us to speak!
* Secret songs for us to keep!
}}

== Location ==
Vaultborn can be found in the [[Whispering Vaults]], unleashed upon the area after the activation of a switch in a hidden room west of the chambers of [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]]. If this is not done by [[Act 3]], a cave-in destroys the room and releases them regardless.

The number of Vaultborn and their locations change upon each entry into the room, except for the one where they were originally held, which always contains exactly three. In three further rooms to the east, their numbers can vary within the ranges of 4–5, 6–8, and 2–3, respectively. Eight Vaultborn can be fought in the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/Whispering_Vaults_2|optional enemy gauntlet]] at the entrance to the Whispering Vaults, which becomes available once the [[Enemy_Gauntlets_(Silksong)/Whispering_Vaults_1|previous gauntlet]] is cleared. Upon re-entering the gauntlet arena, 1–3 Vaultborn can be found.
